high_level_description: This image shows a large white missile monument with the letters "USAF" prominently displayed on its side. The missile is mounted on a pedestal and is encased within a fenced area. The setting appears to be an outdoor park or open space, as there are trees, grass, and a playground structure visible in the background. Two individuals are standing in front of the missile monument. One person is wearing a black hoodie and blue pants, while the other is dressed in a beige hoodie and gray pants.
